en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammapaccanīyānuloma (4), Dukadukapaṭṭhānapāḷi (6) 24.6.
Hetuduka, Mahantaraduka

Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor has an object, there arises a state that is a cause and has an object, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three for the root [condition] … pe … three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor has an object, there arises a state that is neither a cause nor has an object, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three for the root [condition], three for the predominance [condition] … pe … three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor is consciousness, there arises a state that is neither a cause but is consciousness, by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three for the root [condition] … pe … three for non-disappearance.
Dependent on a non-root, non-mental state, a root, non-mental state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a non-root, non-mental-factor state, a root, mental-factor state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-root, non-non-mental-factor state, a non-root, non-non-mental-factor state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-root state that is not associated with consciousness, a root state associated with consciousness arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-root state that is not dissociated from consciousness, a non-root state dissociated from consciousness arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root, three under predominance; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither a root nor associated with consciousness, there arises a state that is a root and associated with consciousness by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither a root nor dissociated from consciousness, there arises a state that is not a root and dissociated from consciousness by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; three under predominance; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-root, non-mentally-originated state, a root, mentally-originated state arises by way of root condition … (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are three … pe … under non-disappearance there are three.

Dependent on a non-root, non-mentally-originated state, a root, non-mentally-originated state arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root [condition] there are three … pe … under non-disappearance there are three.

Dependent on a state that is neither a root nor conascent with consciousness, there arises a state that is a root and conascent with consciousness, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three [answers] for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither a root nor conascent with consciousness, there arises a state that is neither a root nor conascent with consciousness, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three [answers] for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither a root nor a concomitant of consciousness, there arises a state that is a root and a concomitant of consciousness by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three [answers] for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither a root nor a concomitant of consciousness, there arises a state that is neither a root nor a concomitant of consciousness by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three [answers] for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-root phenomenon that is not conjoined with or produced by mind, a root phenomenon that is conjoined with and produced by mind arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-root phenomenon that is neither conjoined with nor produced by mind, a non-root phenomenon that is neither conjoined with nor produced by mind arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-root dhamma that is not conjoined with, not produced by, and not co-existent with consciousness, there arises a root dhamma that is conjoined with, produced by, and co-existent with consciousness, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-root dhamma that is not conjoined with, not produced by, and not co-existent with consciousness, there arises a non-root dhamma that is not conjoined with, not produced by, and not co-existent with consciousness, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three for root; ... pe ... three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-root state that is not conjoined with consciousness, not co-arisen with consciousness, and not a concomitant of consciousness, there arises a root state that is conjoined with consciousness, co-arisen with consciousness, and a concomitant of consciousness, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-root state that is not conjoined with consciousness, not co-arisen with consciousness, and not a concomitant of consciousness, there arises a non-root state that is not conjoined with consciousness, not co-arisen with consciousness, and not a concomitant of consciousness, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a non-causal internal state, a non-causal internal state arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.
Dependent on a non-causal external state, a causal external state arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a non-causal state that is not derived, a non-causal state that is derived arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three under root, three under predominance; ... pe ... three under non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither a cause nor acquired by clinging (*na-hetu na-upādā*), a state that is a cause but not acquired by clinging (*hetu no-upādā*) arises by way of the root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*). (Abbreviated. Under the root-condition there are three; ... pe ... under the non-disappearance condition there are three.
A state that is neither a cause nor acquired by clinging is a condition, by way of the object-condition (*ārammaṇa-paccaya*), for a state that is a cause and acquired by clinging.

(Abbreviated. Under the object-condition there are nine; under the proximity and contiguity conditions there are nine; under the decisive support condition there are nine; under the prenascence condition...
Three [in the case of] kamma; three [in the case of] nutriment; ... pe ... three [in the case of] non-disappearance.

Dependent on a state that is neither-root nor clung-to, there arises a state that is neither-root nor clung-to by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated. Three [in the case of] root; three [in the case of] conascence, dependence, kamma ... pe ... path, dissociation, presence, and non-disappearance.
